parameters.query:
WITH found AS (
  SELECT id, resume_token, status, messages, sections_covered, contact_email, contact_name,
         llm_total_cost_usd, llm_total_tokens, llm_message_count
  FROM onboarding_sessions
  WHERE resume_token = NULLIF($1,'')
    AND status = 'in_progress'
  LIMIT 1
),
new_session AS (
  INSERT INTO onboarding_sessions (contact_email, contact_name)
  SELECT NULLIF($2,''), NULLIF($3,'')
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM found)
  RETURNING id, resume_token, status, messages, sections_covered, contact_email, contact_name,
            llm_total_cost_usd, llm_total_tokens, llm_message_count
)
SELECT * FROM found UNION ALL SELECT * FROM new_session;

SELECT identity, tone, priorities, red_lines, visit_checklist, materials_pref, trades_pref, jurisdiction FROM studio_profile WHERE setup_source = 'baseline' AND active = true ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1;

UPDATE onboarding_sessions SET messages = $1::jsonb, sections_covered = $2::jsonb, llm_total_cost_usd = $3::numeric, llm_total_tokens = $4::int, llm_message_count = $5::int, status = CASE WHEN $6::boolean THEN 'completed' ELSE status END WHERE id = $7::uuid RETURNING id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: $('Parse LLM JSON').first().json.response_message, resume_token: $('Parse LLM JSON').first().json.resume_token, sections_covered: $('Parse LLM JSON').first().json.sections_covered, ready_to_close: $('Parse LLM JSON').first().json.ready_to_close }) }}
